releases.notes:
- New JSON config file more stable
- OPs can spoof player's enderchest and inventory
- Full refactor
- SQLInjection fix
- Renewable elytras
- Mod Files stored in the world directory
- JSON fully configurable inGame
- Vanilla memory leak fixes
- Referenced db
- AdminTp can now @
- Block logging dedicated thread so server doesn't die with more than 5 players digging
- Delete first 100K logs on 1M logs reach with custom thread
- Player data stored in memory onPlayerJoin
- Random bugFixes
